full_install.limitations: Strict 16,128-file seed; downloads and verification are separate. No own compilation, setup or separate benchmark overlapped installation. Host load was observed without a quiet-start requirement. Sampling can miss short-lived competitors and sequential timings do not isolate source effects.

entry_provenance.reason: The mutable entry build directory had different binary hashes and was not accepted as a source of known entry images.

rejected_legacy_seed_run.reason: The legacy seed failed debconf preconfiguration. The workspace acceptance tool changed during the run; the driver independently rejected its harness check. The historical report is retained unchanged.

selection_scope: Compact fd-link storage and selected native open/COW routes have component comparison evidence. The full installation measures their integration under observed load without causal attribution to one route.
